title: Tim Cook leads Apple with a ruthless doctrine - and no one is safe from it, not even the company that put the 'silicon' in 'Silicon Valley' (AAPL, INTC)
text: Tim Cook leads Apple with a ruthless doctrine — and no one is safe from it, not even the company that put the 'silicon' in 'Silicon Valley' (AAPL, INTC) By Kif Leswing Apr 2, 2018, 7:05 pm Apple's said to be looking into technology that would allow it to stop buying laptop processors from Intel. It's the latest sign Apple won't stop until it owns all of its core technology — something CEO Tim Cook vowed to do back in 2009. For nearly 50 years, Intel put the "Silicon" in "Silicon…
